name: Normalized Difference Vegetation Index
range: [-1, 1]; green crop canopies typically 0.2-0.95 (saturates above LAI ~3)
sensitivity: green biomass, canopy cover/vigour, LAI (low-moderate), yield proxy
reference: Rouse, J.W., Haas, R.H., Schell, J.A., Deering, D.W. (1974). Monitoring vegetation systems in the Great Plains with ERTS. Third ERTS Symposium, NASA SP-351, Vol. 1, 309-317.

name: Normalized Difference Red Edge index (red-edge NDVI)
range: [-1, 1]; crop canopies typically 0.1-0.6 (depends on red-edge band centre)
sensitivity: canopy chlorophyll, nitrogen status, less saturation than NDVI in dense canopies
reference: Gitelson, A., Merzlyak, M.N. (1994). Spectral reflectance changes associated with autumn senescence of Aesculus hippocastanum L. and Acer platanoides L. leaves. J. Plant Physiol. 143, 286-292.

name: Green Normalized Difference Vegetation Index
sensitivity: chlorophyll concentration, nitrogen status, biomass; wider dynamic range than NDVI at high LAI
reference: Gitelson, A.A., Kaufman, Y.J., Merzlyak, M.N. (1996). Use of a green channel in remote sensing of global vegetation from EOS-MODIS. Remote Sens. Environ. 58, 289-298.

name: Soil-Adjusted Vegetation Index (L = 0.5)
range: [-1, 1] for reflectance in 0-1; crop canopies typically 0.1-0.8
sensitivity: green cover/biomass and LAI with reduced soil-background effect (sparse/early canopies)
reference: Huete, A.R. (1988). A soil-adjusted vegetation index (SAVI). Remote Sens. Environ. 25, 295-309.

name: Ratio Vegetation Index / Simple Ratio (SR)
sensitivity: LAI, green biomass, canopy chlorophyll content; linear at high biomass (no saturation like NDVI)
reference: Jordan, C.F. (1969). Derivation of leaf-area index from quality of light on the forest floor. Ecology 50, 663-666.

name: Optimized Soil-Adjusted Vegetation Index
range: [-0.86, 0.86] for reflectance in 0-1 (x1.16 if the scaled variant is used); crops typically 0.1-0.8
sensitivity: LAI, green cover, biomass with soil-background correction; denominator of TCARI/OSAVI
reference: Rondeaux, G., Steven, M., Baret, F. (1996). Optimization of soil-adjusted vegetation indices. Remote Sens. Environ. 55, 95-107.

name: Normalized Green-Red Difference Index (also GRVI)
sensitivity: green canopy fraction, early-season biomass, phenology/senescence, vegetation segmentation
reference: Tucker, C.J. (1979). Red and photographic infrared linear combinations for monitoring vegetation. Remote Sens. Environ. 8, 127-150. (Named NGRDI by Hunt et al. 2005, Precis. Agric. 6, 359-378, doi:10.1007/s11119-005-2324-5.)

name: Red-edge Chlorophyll Index (CI red-edge)
sensitivity: canopy chlorophyll content, nitrogen uptake, GPP; near-linear with chlorophyll (no saturation)
reference: Gitelson, A.A., Gritz, Y., Merzlyak, M.N. (2003). Relationships between leaf chlorophyll content and spectral reflectance and algorithms for non-destructive chlorophyll assessment in higher plant leaves. J. Plant Physiol. 160, 271-282; canopy form: Gitelson et al. (2005) Geophys. Res. Lett. 32, L08403, doi:10.1029/2005GL022688.

name: Green Chlorophyll Index (CI green)
sensitivity: canopy chlorophyll content, nitrogen status, GPP/productivity, biomass
reference: Gitelson, A.A., Gritz, Y., Merzlyak, M.N. (2003). J. Plant Physiol. 160, 271-282; canopy form: Gitelson et al. (2005) Geophys. Res. Lett. 32, L08403, doi:10.1029/2005GL022688.

name: Modified Soil-Adjusted Vegetation Index (self-adjusting L, MSAVI2)
sensitivity: green cover, LAI and biomass in sparse canopies with strong soil background
reference: Qi, J., Chehbouni, A., Huete, A.R., Kerr, Y.H., Sorooshian, S. (1994). A modified soil adjusted vegetation index. Remote Sens. Environ. 48, 119-126.

name: Difference Vegetation Index
range: [-1, 1] for reflectance in 0-1; crop canopies typically 0.1-0.6
sensitivity: green biomass, LAI, canopy cover; sensitive to soil background and illumination
reference: Tucker, C.J. (1979). Red and photographic infrared linear combinations for monitoring vegetation. Remote Sens. Environ. 8, 127-150.

name: Modified Chlorophyll Absorption in Reflectance Index
range: unbounded (can be negative); narrow-band crops typically 0-1.5, broad-band UAV values lower
sensitivity: leaf chlorophyll (confounded by LAI/soil); used with OSAVI to isolate chlorophyll
reference: Daughtry, C.S.T., Walthall, C.L., Kim, M.S., Brown de Colstoun, E., McMurtrey, J.E. (2000). Estimating corn leaf chlorophyll concentration from leaf and canopy reflectance. Remote Sens. Environ. 74, 229-239.

name: Two-band Enhanced Vegetation Index (EVI without blue)
range: [-0.74, 1.25] for reflectance in 0-1; crop canopies typically 0.1-0.9
sensitivity: green biomass, LAI, canopy structure; less saturation than NDVI; blue-free substitute for EVI
reference: Jiang, Z., Huete, A.R., Didan, K., Miura, T. (2008). Development of a two-band enhanced vegetation index without a blue band. Remote Sens. Environ. 112, 3833-3845.

name: Transformed Chlorophyll Absorption in Reflectance Index / Optimized SAVI ratio
range: unbounded (undefined where OSAVI ~0, i.e. bare soil); crop canopies typically 0-1; LOWER value = MORE chlorophyll
sensitivity: leaf chlorophyll content / N status, minimised LAI and soil effects; water/nutrient stress
reference: Haboudane, D., Miller, J.R., Tremblay, N., Zarco-Tejada, P.J., Dextraze, L. (2002). Integrated narrow-band vegetation indices for prediction of crop chlorophyll content for application to precision agriculture. Remote Sens. Environ. 81, 416-426.

name: MERIS Terrestrial Chlorophyll Index
range: unbounded (denominator -> 0 over soil/water); green canopies typically 0.5-6
sensitivity: canopy chlorophyll content, nitrogen status, red-edge position proxy; little saturation
reference: Dash, J., Curran, P.J. (2004). The MERIS terrestrial chlorophyll index. Int. J. Remote Sens. 25, 5403-5413.
